description: Circle CCTP V2 USDC between Base and Ethereum, counted from ASPERN’s stored index (since 2026-11-24): per direction (base->ethereum, ethereum->base, each with a human label), USDC burned a day in native units with decimals (the burn counted once per transfer; the mint is the same transfer less the fee, never added), transfers and completed, and the median and 90th-percentile seconds from the source block to the destination block that minted, overall and by the finality executed (confirmed = fast, finalized = standard), and `medianSays`: the median in words, or why there is none yet (no mint read yet: the index job traces a bounded number of burns a run; its schedule is in `index.job`). `scale` is ONE scale across both directions (the largest day of either), so daily bars drawn from it compare amounts. `parties` splits the transfers into known_agent (the sender or recipient is an agent identity ASPERN reads: ERC-8004 registrant, holder or agentWallet, an ACP client or provider, an x402 payer with a decoded payload), contract_other (a contract named by its operator or a deployment list, such as the LI.FI router) and unclassified, with counts and shares of transfers and USDC, per direction and per day (`perDay[].byParty`); unclassified is NOT human, it means nothing read names either address. `index.state` says what the index holds: read, not_yet_read (the index job has not run yet: nothing here says there was no traffic) or unavailable. `covered` per direction says from and through when. Never claims the addresses share an owner, that an AI agent acted, or that anything was autonomous. One transfer: cross_chain_trace. FREE.

days.description: Window in days, default 30, at most 365.

name: cross_chain_stats

directions.description: Per route: route, label, sourceNetwork, destinationNetwork, covered (from, through, messages, notYetSettled; null before the index read that chain), transfers, completed, amount (native), amountFormatted, perDay [day, transfers, completed, amount, amountFormatted, byParty], medianSeconds, p90Seconds, medianSays, byFinality [finality, completed, medianSeconds, p90Seconds], parties (per class: transfers, amount, amountFormatted, shareOfAmount, shareOfTransfers).

index.description: state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), says, readSince, job (enabled, everyMinutes, lastRunAt; null when unread) and cadenceSays.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

notClaimed.description: What no figure here establishes: same owner, an AI agent, autonomy, same coins.

parties.description: state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), says, labels, means, totals per class (transfers, amount, amountFormatted, shareOfAmount, shareOfTransfers; null unless read), addresses (total and per class), evidence (addresses per kind), evidenceSays, basis.

says.description: One sentence per direction, or why there are no figures.

scale.description: shared (true), maxDayAmount (native), maxDayAmountFormatted, maxDayTransfers, says: one scale for every direction.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

window.description: from, through and days: every UTC day of the window, oldest first.

title: Cross-chain statistics (CCTP V2, Base <-> Ethereum)
